title: Loadsmith: percentile benchmarking harness, dynamic baselines, and regression gate for per-route/model/region
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: We lack a standardized, reproducible harness that ties synthetic tokens/sec load profiles to per-route/model/region p95 and p99 baselines and automated regression gates. Consequences: flaky rollouts, noisy alerts, and slow RCA.

Proposal: Build 'Loadsmith' — an orchestrated benchmark runner + telemetry normalizer + quantile explorer with a regression-gate service. Key pieces:
- Harness: declarative load profiles (tokens/sec, concurrency, prompt length distribution), deterministic KV cache seeding, and scenario playback.
- Telemetry normalizer: ingest raw latency histograms and emit normalized p50/p95/p99 per route/model/region with sample counts and confidence intervals.
- Dynamic baselines: per-slice exponential decay baselines (configurable windows) and seasonality-aware adjustments.
- Regression gate: daily/PR checks that run controlled benches and test statistical changes using bootstrap confidence intervals and Mann-Whitney U as fallback; produces a pass/fail score and links to the explorer.
- Explorer/Dashboard: Grafana panels with heatmaps, 'delta lanes' comparing current run to baseline, tokens/sec vs percentile scatterplots, and a timeline of baselines.

Acceptance criteria:
1) CI integration: PRs running Loadsmith against a pinned model variant produce a summary artifact and a regression decision comment.
2) Grafana dashboard with per-route/model/region selector and delta overlay.
3) Alerts: auto-create a regression incident when p95 regressions exceed configurable effect size and confidence threshold.
4) Documentation: runbook, reproducible recipe, and example profiles checked into infra/loadsmith/profiles.
5) End-to-end demo: compare a known regression (quantization change) and show detection within 1 day.

2026-03-04: Prototype runner implemented; synthetic profile language (YAML) v0.1 committed in infra/loadsmith; PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/loadsmith/pull/12
2026-03-06: Telemetry normalization spike completed — emitting p50/p95/p99 with sample_count and 95% CI to metric.store (metric names: loadsmith.percentile.*)
2026-03-08: Stat testing review — decided on bootstrap CI + Mann-Whitney for non-parametric checks; added CUSUM exploration for continuous drift alarms
2026-03-10: Dashboard wireframes uploaded; Grafana workspace 'loadsmith-quantiles' provisioned. Mock panels: heatmap, delta-lane, tokens/sec scatter
2026-03-12: Integration plan with CI and PR gating approved; security review not required for first-phase (no customer data).
